text_block_list.text:
Everyone wanted to catch a glimpse of Silence Suzuka,
who had displayed such overwhelmingly dominant running across countless races!
The racecourse was overflowing with spectators eager to see her!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I wonder if Suzuka's going to be amazing today too...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Knowing her, she might be in even crazier shape
than she was for the Mainichi Okan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Right?! More than who wins or loses the race,
I'm just excited to see her...!

—Yet in contrast to the mounting excitement in the stands,
a heavy atmosphere hung over the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there is something
I must speak with you about.
She quietly yet clearly explained—about the pain in her leg, and the reason she refused to give up on running anyway—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Even so, I want to run today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I don't know what the future holds.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: However, we can surpass our limits together. I truly believe all we have to do is run through with that conviction.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Just like you believed in me at the very beginning,
won't you believe in me just one more time?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I promise.
I will... come back, without fail.
Her eyes were full of strength as she said that.

"I'll be waiting at the goal."
When I said that, she gave a delighted smile.

"I'll be waiting at the finish line."
Saying that, she smiled happily.
